written_before: any draw, any solve, any spectrum. Every later phase recomputes these hashes and refuses to run on a mismatch.

operating_point_rule.substitution: next candidate in ascending rank order; each recorded

ordering_statistic.metric: max relative movement of the leading singular values
ordering_statistic.stable_requires: both statistics give the same order at that point

barrier_criterion.metric: profile likelihood barrier depth, straight line in chart coordinates
barrier_criterion.floor_reference: 0.5 * B_certified log-units, the cost of a curve one noise unit away at every bias
barrier_criterion.null_control: the same criterion over the same number of ordinary prior draws that form no witness pair, taken in draw order

generation_8_operating_point: witness pair 0 member a of outputs/global_identifiability_g6/global_identifiability.json, chart G d=4, collocated or projected into each chart; bias window 0.15-0.90 V, 16 linear points. Re-measured here as a reproduction control, and excluded from the count of *further* operating points.
what_would_falsify_g9_1: the ordering changes at any operating point. Pre-registered as reportable either way (AH-04, AH-13): a flip converts the headline to 'the ordering is itself operating-point dependent', which is weaker and still publishable.
